An unsupported request media type must return 415 Unsupported Media Type.

What the Standard says

RFC 9110 defines 415 for a request that the origin server refuses because the content format is not supported by the target resource or method. Read section 15.5.16.

Why it matters

A precise 415 response lets callers correct Content-Type or content encoding without mistaking a representation problem for validation or server failure.

Bad code example

catch (OrderUnsupportedMediaException)
{
    return BadRequest();
}

Good code example

catch (OrderUnsupportedMediaException)
{
    return StatusCode(statusCode: 415);
}
